# EXPLORATORY / POST HOC: a parameter-free necessary condition for sparse prefill to pay (28 Nov 2026)

**EXPLORATORY / POST HOC. Nothing is scored; no parameter is fitted on P1–P4; nothing is measured.** Generated by `scripts/pay_bound.py`; numbers in `pay_bound.json`. The derivation is in `attnbench/exploratory/pay_bound.py`.

A sparse cell can pay only if LB = max(B + n_sync·f, N·f) < T_dense, with B the traced device-busy time, f the bare-timed null-kernel launch floor, N the issued operations and n_sync the in-step synchronisations.

| pairing | B read from | sparse cells | measured wins | violations | losses ruled out | LB above measured sparse | median T_sparse / LB | min |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P2 | traced | 29 | 4 | 0 | 17 of 25 | 2 | 1.26 | 0.98 |
| P2 | priced (before timing) | 29 | 4 | 0 | 14 of 25 | 0 | 1.50 | 1.03 |
| P4 | traced | 29 | 1 | 0 | 26 of 28 | 0 | 1.67 | 1.03 |
| P4 | priced (before timing) | 29 | 1 | 0 | 26 of 28 | 0 | 1.69 | 1.03 |

**Verdict: valid on every cell; separates at least one measured loss**
